beats.label: S1 · Out of the deep woods
beats.text: A year after Pubba dies of the Sick, Gus leaves Yellowstone to find Birdie in Colorado; poachers snatch him and a gruff loner, Jepperd, saves him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The road-trip pairing that carries the whole series starts here.

beats.label: S1 · The man he used to be
beats.text: Escorting Gus toward Colorado, Jepperd is outed as a former Last Man who once hunted hybrids. Gus doesn't care — Jepperd is his friend.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Jepperd's guilt, which drives every choice he makes afterward.

beats.label: S1 · The Preserve
beats.text: In the ruined city, therapist Aimee Eden makes a home at an abandoned zoo, adopts a hybrid piglet named Wendy, and turns it into a Preserve for other hybrids.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Preserve becomes the trap Gus is caught in and the site Jepperd storms next season.

beats.label: S1 · Singh's bargain
beats.text: To keep his infected wife Rani alive, Dr. Singh accepts General Abbot's supplies and becomes the Last Men's tame cure-hunting scientist.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Singh as the season's compromised inside man and Abbot's leverage over him.

beats.label: S1 · A boy made in a lab
beats.text: Reaching Essex County, Gus reads Birdie's files and learns he isn't her son — he was a lab experiment she and Pubba smuggled out. He runs into the woods, gutted.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rewrites who Gus is and why he exists, framing the cure-vs-child fight going forward.

beats.label: S1 · The Preserve falls
beats.text: The Last Men raid the Preserve and cage Gus with the other hybrids. Aimee finds a wounded Jepperd, and the two vow to get their children back.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks Gus in Abbot's hands and forges the Aimee-Jepperd rescue partnership that opens S2.

beats.label: S1 · Sister and mother
beats.text: Bear reveals she's really Becky Walker — Wendy's adoptive sister, taken from her by the Sick. Her phone rings: it's Birdie, hiding in the Arctic with her research.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Becky on a collision course with Wendy and finally makes Birdie a live character, not a photo.

cliffhanger.text: Gus and the other hybrids are caged inside Abbot's Preserve while Singh is forced to hunt a cure. Jepperd and Aimee are coming for them, and Birdie has finally surfaced from the Arctic.
questions: Can Jepperd and Aimee break their kids out of the Preserve?
What will Singh do now that he finally has live hybrid subjects?
Will Birdie reach Gus, or will Abbot reach her first?

characters.name: Gus
characters.line: Deer hybrid boy, caged at the Preserve, still believing Birdie is his mother waiting for him.

characters.name: Tommy Jepperd
characters.line: Ex-Last Man protector who failed to keep Gus safe; now teamed with Aimee to break him out.

characters.name: Aimee Eden
characters.line: Founder of the Preserve; her adopted hybrids have been taken, and she is coming for Abbot with Jepperd.

characters.name: Dr. Aditya Singh
characters.line: Reluctant scientist serving Abbot in exchange for the treatments keeping Rani alive.

characters.name: Rani Singh
characters.line: Singh's wife; secretly has the Sick and is quarantined in a special room at the Preserve.

characters.name: General Abbot
characters.line: Brutal leader of the Last Men; now controls the Preserve, the captured hybrids, and Singh's cure work.

characters.name: Becky 'Bear' Walker
characters.line: Former Animal Army leader who has just realised the caged Wendy is her long-lost sister.

characters.name: Wendy
characters.line: Aimee's adopted pig hybrid; caged at the Preserve, unaware that Bear is her sister.

characters.name: Birdie
characters.line: Geneticist who engineered Gus; hidden in the Arctic with her research and just made phone contact.

beats.label: S2 · A deal in the lab
beats.text: Caged at the Preserve, Gus is dragged into Singh's lab and agrees to help him find a cure in exchange for the hybrids' safety.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Recasts Singh from captor to conflicted collaborator, the relationship that carries S3.

beats.label: S2 · Fort Smith and the microbes
beats.text: Singh drives Gus to Fort Smith, where a tape reveals Birdie ran Project Midnight Sun and Gus was born from the same Arctic microbes that spawned the Sick.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ties Gus and the Sick to a single origin in Alaska, the destination of everything that follows.

beats.label: S2 · The rescue that isn't
beats.text: Jepperd and Aimee try to storm the Preserve and are captured. Learning Jepperd was once a hybrid catcher, Aimee cuts him from the rescue team.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the outside adults on the back foot and forces Jepperd to earn his way back into the mission.

beats.label: S2 · Evergreen and Zhang
beats.text: Abbot pitches Singh's fake cure to three warlord allies at a summit for a walled Evergreen community; Helen Zhang murders her rivals to claim it all for herself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Zhang, who is the entire villain problem of S3.

beats.label: S2 · Sister on the inside
beats.text: Becky infiltrates the Last Men and turns Tiger to her side; she finds Wendy at the Preserve but keeps quiet that they are sisters.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Becky in the raid and quietly stages the Wendy reveal.

beats.label: S2 · Fake flowers, real escape
beats.text: The hybrids escape during a staged Air Lord flower attack; Aimee torches Singh's lab and Rani walks out on him. As they flee, Aimee shows symptoms of the Sick.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frees the hybrids, breaks Singh's marriage, and plants Aimee's death sentence.

beats.label: S2 · Yellowstone and Alaska
beats.text: Bison trample Abbot and Aimee dies of the Sick. Gus, Jepperd, Becky and Wendy set off for Birdie in Alaska; Singh, sharing the vision, follows. Zhang readies her forces to pursue.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Clears Abbot off the board, kills Aimee, and points every remaining player at Alaska.

cliffhanger.text: Gus and his rescued friends are racing north to find Birdie in Alaska, chased by Zhang's forces and shadowed by Singh, who is still convinced Gus holds the cure.
questions: Can they reach Birdie in Alaska before Zhang does?
What does the shared vision of the cave actually want from Gus?
How far will Singh go now that Rani is gone?

characters.name: Gus
characters.line: Free again after the Preserve; heading north for Birdie with the group.

characters.name: Tommy Jepperd
characters.line: Grieving Aimee and resolved to get Gus safely to his mother in Alaska.

characters.name: Dr. Aditya Singh
characters.line: Lost Rani and his lab; trailing Gus's group north, gripped by visions of an Alaskan cave.
characters.note: Still believes a cure is possible through Gus.

characters.name: Becky Walker
characters.line: Has told Wendy the truth about being sisters and is travelling with the group.
characters.note: Former Animal Army leader, briefly an undercover Last Man.

characters.name: Wendy
characters.line: Reunited with her sister Becky, heading to Alaska with the others.

characters.name: Helen Zhang
characters.line: New warlord who executed her rivals and now vows to finish what Abbot started with the hybrids.

characters.name: Birdie
characters.line: Gus's engineered mother; still in Alaska with her research, hunted by Gillian Washington's people.

characters.name: Rani Singh
characters.line: Walked out on her husband when he chose the cure over her; whereabouts unknown.

beats.label: S3 · Singh joins the road
beats.text: Heading north, Gus's group meets Singh at a roadside motel; he joins them, guided by visions of the same Alaskan cave. Feral wolf hybrids stalk their trail.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the antagonist inside the wagon and introduces the wolf-boy pursuers.

beats.label: S3 · Munaq finds Birdie
beats.text: In Alaska, Birdie is hunted by one of Zhang's men and rescued by a mysterious caribou-man, Munaq, who takes her to a hidden church and asks about Gus.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Munaq as the character who will finally explain the Sick.

beats.label: S3 · Split at the coast
beats.text: At the reef the group miss their ship; Zhang's daughter Rosie catches Becky, while Gus, Jepperd and Singh sail on alone toward an abandoned freighter.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fractures the party and puts Gus and Singh alone at sea, where the betrayal can land.

beats.label: S3 · Crossing to Alaska
beats.text: On the plague ship, immune Gus dumps the infected dead and restarts the engines himself, setting a course for Alaska. Wendy stows away on Zhang's plane.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Gets the two halves of the group both to Alaska ahead of the collision.

beats.label: S3 · Singh sells Gus out
beats.text: In Alaska, Siana and her hybrid daughter Nuka shelter the group, but Singh — now convinced Gus must be sacrificed — hands him to Zhang. Munaq rescues Gus.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The betrayal the whole season builds toward, and the pivot that leads Gus to Birdie.

beats.label: S3 · Mother, then loss
beats.text: Gus reunites with Birdie. Munaq reveals a Dr. Thacker unleashed the Sick from the cave, naming humanity the true disease. In the cave, Birdie dies shielding Gus from Singh's blow.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delivers the season's promised reunion and immediately takes Birdie away — the emotional core of the finale.

beats.label: S3 · The tree burns
beats.text: Zhang's axe frees the sap and infects every human. Gus burns the tree, curing them all; Singh dies saving him, and years later an elderly Gus tells the tale to hybrid children.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The world-changing act the whole series has been pointing at, plus the coda that closes it.

cliffhanger.text: With the Sick cured and the tree destroyed, Gus's friends build a hybrid sanctuary at Yellowstone. Years later, an elderly Gus finishes his story to the children gathered around him.
questions: What became of the surviving humans after the cure?
Has the wider world healed, or splintered beyond Yellowstone?
Whose children are these, and what kind of world will they inherit?

characters.name: Gus
characters.line: Cured the world by burning the sap-tree; in the coda, an elderly hybrid recounting his life at the Yellowstone sanctuary.

characters.name: Tommy Jepperd
characters.line: Survived the cave; helps run the hybrid sanctuary at Yellowstone.

characters.name: Becky Walker
characters.line: Survived Rosie's capture and the crash of Zhang's drill; safe with Wendy at the sanctuary.

characters.name: Wendy
characters.line: Safe with her sister Becky at Yellowstone.

characters.name: Birdie
characters.line: Gus's engineered mother; killed shielding him from Singh's blow inside the cave.

characters.name: Dr. Aditya Singh
characters.line: Turned on Zhang at the last moment and sacrificed himself so Gus could escape the collapsing cave.

characters.name: Helen Zhang
characters.line: Her drilling machine wrecked, her men walked away from her; the axe strike that reinfected every human was hers.

characters.name: Munaq
characters.line: Caribou-man who sheltered Birdie and revealed Thacker's cave as the source of the Sick before dying of his wounds.

characters.name: Rosie Zhang
characters.line: Zhang's estranged daughter and mother of the feral wolf hybrid boys who hunted Gus across the north.
